newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 recovers on technical gains.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 recovers on technical gains.

text.p: The Czech PX50 recovered from early losses to close up more than one percent at 541.5 on Tuesday with the top three major issues making most of the running.
However, traders said they saw few fundamental reasons for the rise.

Some suggested that foreign investors may have decided to firm up their positions in the Czech Republic on the grounds that after strong gains in recent years in Poland and Hungary Prague was bound to be next.
"Fundamentally there's really no optimism...but after Hungary and Poland...some really believe that now is the time to go long into Czech papers," said Radim Bajgar of ING Barings.

Earlier on Tuesday, the PX50's fourth most heavily weighted share, Ceska Sporitelna posted first half net profits according to international accounting standards of 632 million crowns from 1.4 billion. The issue dropped three crowns to 276.
The bank also said its full year net profits would fall several hundred million crowns below the 2.5 billion originally estimated.
